Kit summary

Heavy Blade SlashBasic
Deals [Bleed] DMG by 10% of Reyna's Max HP to a single enemy and removes 1 layer of a buff from them. Meanwhile, there is a 100% chance to inflict [Provoke] for 1 turn. Replaces this skill with Heavy Blade Slash · Resonance in the duration of [Resonance Enhancement].
Blade RaidActive
Deals 2 stages of [Bleed]DMG by 15% of Reyna's Max HP each to all enemies. The first stage has a 100% chance of inflicting [Cold II] for 2 turns and the second stage has a 35% chance of inflicting [Stun] for 1 turn.
Guard of the WildnessPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Reyna is immune to [Stun], [Freeze], [Hypnotize], and [Imprison]. Max Limit of Resonance Points: 25. When a battle starts, Reyna gains 20 points. When allies gain any [Shield], grants Reyna 1 Resonance Point and each ally can only grant Reyna 1 Resonance Point in this way before their next turns start. When the Resonance Points reach the max limit, Reyna consumes all of them, gains [Resonance Enhancement] for 2 turns, and replaces Heavy Blade Slash with Heavy Blade Slash · Resonance. In the duration of [Resonance Enhancement], Reyna cannot get Resonance Points anymore and her Max HP is increased by 40% of self Healing Effect, up to 52% of the Max HP can be increased. When Reyna gains [Resonance Enhancement] for the first time each wave, grants all allies 1 layer of [Back to Life] for 3 turns. [Back to Life]: When the owner takes Fatal DMG, consumes 1 layer to be immune to death and restores HP by 20% of Reyna's Max HP.
Heavy Axe of Blood Lv.1When Reyna is in the duration of [Resonance Enhancement] and any ally is trying to inflict Control effect on an enemy, Reyna will pursue and attack the enemy once. Each enemy can be pursued and attacked by this effect up to 3 times in each of their turns.
Heavy Axe of Blood Lv.2Extends the duration of [Resonance Enhancement] to 4 turns. When [Back to Life] is triggered, increases its HP Restoration to 180% of the original and cleanses all debuffs from this ally.
Maid's ProtectionActiveExclusive Lv.3
Restores all allies' HP by 15% of Reyna's Max HP and grants them a [Shield] equal to 45% of Reyna's Max HP for 2 turns. Besides, additionally casts Maid's Protection once when any ally's HP is lower than 50%; this effect can be triggered again after Reyna acts 4 turns.
Heavy Axe of Blood Lv.3Increases Reyna's Mastery by 50% of self Healing Effect, up to 75% can be increased. When Reyna casts Maid's Protection proactively or because of other effects: 1. If self Healing Effect is no lower than 100%, increases the value of [Shield] granted to 60% of Reyna's Max HP. 2. If self Healing Effect is no lower than 150%, [Shield] granted cannot be removed and its duration is increased to 3 turns. When 5 or more allies survive, Reyna gains [Immortal].
Heavy Blade Slash · ResonanceBasicExclusive Lv.1
Deals [Bleed] DMG (considered as Resonance DMG) by 10% of Reyna's Max HP to a single enemy and removes 1 layer of a buff from them. For every 1 layer of Control effect owned by the target, increases [Bleed] DMG dealt by Reyna to the target by 100%, caps at 300% of the original (this DMG ignores [Shield]). Meanwhile, there is a 100% chance to inflict [Provoke] for 1 turn.
Heavy Axe of Blood Lv.1When Reyna is in the duration of [Resonance Enhancement] and any ally is trying to inflict Control effect on an enemy, Reyna will pursue and attack the enemy once. Each enemy can be pursued and attacked by this effect up to 3 times in each of their turns.
